en: Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4), Tikatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (5) 23.56. The Triplet on Visibility, The Triplet on the Past The Triplet on Visibility and the Triplet on the Past:
Exposition of the Textual Tradition of the Threefold Triplet.

A non-manifesting, non-reactive, non-present state is a condition, by way of object-condition, for a non-manifesting, non-reactive present state. (Abbreviated. There are six [conditions] in the case of the object;
six in the case of predominance; three in the cases of proximity, contiguity, and decisive support; and three in the cases of absence and disappearance.
